title: Deterministic checks
acceptance: Given an output, then contains, not contains, regex, valid JSON and max words evaluate to pass or fail with a detail.

title: Matrix runner
acceptance: Given variants and cases, then every cell runs with bounded concurrency, progress is reported, and a failing model call becomes an errored cell.

title: LLM judge checks
acceptance: Given a judge criterion, then a model call answers yes or no and the result is recorded as a check.
evidence: PR 1: judge parsing and demo-model run.

title: Run history and regressions
acceptance: Given two runs, then cells matched by variant name and case input are flagged as regressions or fixes.
Given a run in which any call failed, then it is shown with the failure message but is not saved, not compared, has no BEST badge and no cost line.
evidence: PR 2: diff tests; failed runs are excluded from history, BEST and cost (QA BUG-008).

title: Side by side output diff
acceptance: Given two variants on one case, then a word-level diff and similarity percentage are shown.
evidence: PR 2: diff tests; verified in Chrome.

title: Cost estimate
acceptance: Given a suite and a model, then the number of calls and an estimated cost are shown before and after a run, using rough list prices.
evidence: PR 2: estimate tests. Prices are rough and must be rechecked.

title: Offline demo model
acceptance: Given the demo mode, then the sample suite runs with no key and produces differing pass rates across variants.
evidence: PR 1: sample run scored 0, 100 and 50 percent in Chrome.

title: Provider keys kept in the session by default
acceptance: Given a provider key, then it is kept in sessionStorage for the tab by default, kept on the device only when the user ticks "Remember on this device", and removable with "Clear key"; keys are never part of the saved lab state.
Given saved lab state with an unexpected shape or oversized fields, then it is ignored instead of applied.
evidence: In Chrome with an invalid test key the key stayed in sessionStorage and was absent from eval-lab.state.v1 (SEC-002, SEC-009).

title: Costly regex assertions are refused
acceptance: Given a regex assertion with nested quantifiers or more than 300 characters, then it fails with a clear message instead of running.
evidence: A catastrophic pattern returns in under 500 ms instead of 71 s (SEC-009).

title: Content Security Policy on the static export
acceptance: Given the Pages export, then every page carries a Content-Security-Policy meta tag that allows scripts only from the site and from the hashes of its inline scripts, and connections only to the site, api.anthropic.com and api.openai.com.
evidence: Hash and policy tests; published site checked in Chrome after deploy (SEC-001).
